content: The corrigendum, dated August 14, 2023, pertains to the consolidated guidelines on person-centered HIV strategic information, specifically focusing on strengthening routine data for impact. In the Web Annex G.11, on page 6, Figure 11 represents data from the sampled clinic. The viral load (VL) suppression indicator reflects only individuals who had a VL test result available. If 30% or more of the data for any Early Warning Indicators (EWIs) are missing, a grey score is assigned, and no prevalence estimate is reported. This correction has been incorporated into the electronic file.
